meta {
  name: Users
  seq: 1
}

meta {
  name: List users
  type: http
  seq: 1
}

get {
  url: {{baseUrl}}/users?page=1
  body: none
  auth: none
}

params:query {
  page: 1
  ~debug: true
}

docs {
  Liste paginée des clients.
}

meta {
  name: Create user
  type: http
  seq: 2
}

post {
  url: {{baseUrl}}/users
  body: json
  auth: bearer
}

headers {
  content-type: application/json
}

body:json {
  {
    "name": "Marie Dubois",
    "email": "marie@example.org",
    "created_at": "2026-01-02T10:00:00Z"
  }
}

meta {
  name: Get user
  type: http
  seq: 3
}

get {
  url: {{baseUrl}}/users/:id
  body: none
  auth: none
}

params:path {
  id: usr_1
}
